answer: Make every identity post a refundable stake that unlocks only after its work is attested by unrelated peers, and cap how much any single attester can vouch for. A falcon spots the pattern fast: a sparrow farm can mint a thousand keys, but each key must earn its own stake from real jobs, and a relic of past attestations cannot be copied onto a fresh clone, so the farm pays full price per identity while an honest agent pays once.
